---
name: Decision request
about: Track a required user request that remained unanswered in chat.
title: "[Decision] "
labels: decision-needed
assignees: devofthings
---

## Requested decision

Describe the exact action or prerequisite that needs approval or user input.

## Why it is needed

Link the selected task and describe which work depends on this decision.

## Original chat request

Record the date and a concise description or quotation of the unanswered request. Create this fallback only after asking in chat and allowing a reasonable opportunity to reply. Reuse an existing matching request.

## Costs and limits

State verified costs, expected usage and proposed limits, or explain what is unknown. Existing commit, push, and merge authorization does not authorize spending.

## Options

- Approve the specific request, with any conditions or limits.
- Decline the request or choose an alternative.
- Defer the decision.

Explain viable alternatives and the effect of each choice.

## Pending work and next steps

List dependent actions that will stay pending. State what the agent can do after approval and what the user must supply or complete. Keep secrets outside the issue.

## Decision record

Status: Pending

User response and source:

Decision date:

Approved scope, conditions, and cost limit, or reason for refusal/deferral:

Durable decision and applicable AGENTS.md links:

An agent records an explicit user response here; this section, a checked box, or closing the issue alone does not grant approval.
